crumb: Last breadcrumb on a socio's Soul page. "Soul" is a product noun: a socio's (AI agent's) character and instructions.
title: Page title; {{name}} is the socio's name. "Soul" is a product noun.
description: Under the title; {{name}} is the socio's name, "Socio" the product. _owner: a personal socio, which only its owner edits; plain: a workspace socio, which admins edit.
this-socio: Stands in for the socio's name while the page loads.
someone: Stands in for a person whose name is unknown, in "Made by …" and "Edited by …".
in-use: Heading and badge: the Soul version the socio uses now.
origin.migrated: How the first version came to be: copied from the socio's older role instructions when Soul was introduced.
origin.created: {{name}} is the person who made the version.
origin.restored: {{name}} is the person; {{version}} is the number of the older version they brought back.
origin.edited: {{name}} is the person who edited it.
no-persona: The socio's Soul has instructions only. _editable: for people who may edit it, pointing at the Edit button.
toggle.changes: The toggle.* keys: Button on a version in the history: Hide its details, show its Changes from the version before, or Show it (the first version).
same: A version that changed nothing from the one before.
editor.optional: After the label of an optional part of the Soul. Keep the parentheses unless your language marks asides differently.
editor.preview: Button that shows the text the socio reads; {{name}} is the socio's name.
restore.title: Confirm before bringing back an older version; {{version}} is its number.
restore.body: {{name}} is the socio's name; {{next}} is the number the restored copy gets.
restore.done: Toast; {{version}} is the restored version's number.
